name: CodeSleuth
tagline: AI-powered code quality analysis with intelligent improvement suggestions
description: CodeSleuth automatically scans your codebase for quality issues, security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks. Using advanced pattern matching and AI analysis, it provides actionable suggestions to improve your code quality, reduce technical debt, and enhance security posture.
pricing_model: Freemium - Free for public repos, $19/month for private repos, $99/month for teams
estimated_roi_per_business: Reduces code review time by 40% and catches critical vulnerabilities early
